First, I want to say this: the fixed system worked perfectly. Four minutes from detection to control. The compartment was closed, there was no distress call, and nobody was hurt. On paper, it was a good day. But the numbers do not show everything. Two people came to the wrong muster station and asked me where to go. Later, I tried to open the forward locker, and I could not. Somebody had painted it shut at the last dry dock. We were four minutes and a closed door away from a very different day. The order to abandon ship was never given. That is the only reason those two problems did not cost us more.
